name: scenario_Firmware_MoonBase_joins_the_apps_network
description: MoonBase, the recovery image in the factory slot, joins the network the app knows, so an update can download and a user finds the device where it was. The device restarts in MoonBase, which reads the first known network out of the app's network config and answers at the same address; it then boots the app, which comes back on its network. It restarts the device twice and needs a board with MoonBase, so it runs only when named, on a device on WiFi.

steps.name: on-its-network
steps.description: The device starts on WiFi, with the network it knows.

steps.name: restart-in-moonbase
steps.description: The card's Restart in MoonBase button.

steps.name: moonbase-on-the-same-network
steps.description: MoonBase answers at the same address, so it read the network from the app's config and joined it. The app answers this path with 404, MoonBase with its status.

steps.name: back-to-the-app
steps.description: MoonBase's Boot the app button, with nothing installed.

steps.name: still-on-its-network
steps.description: The app comes back on the network it knew, its config untouched by the round trip.
